_comment: Screener.in 'Industry' is the canonical taxonomy (spec section 7). Matching is case-insensitive substring against that column. Refresh the tailwind list quarterly - spec section 3 calls it an explicit moving target.
_p2_exceptions_note: CONFIRMED-IN-CHAT: broad capital-intensive set gets the relaxed ROCE >=10% bar.
_tailwind_note: Five sectors from spec section 3 P8. IT services deliberately excluded.

_tailwind_review._note: This list is a human 3-year forward macro judgement, NOT something the app derives from live news. The app cannot forecast which sectors will lead; it only checks membership in this list plus a verifiable top-3-by-market-cap rank from Screener.in's own industry tables. Re-research quarterly and update both the list and last_reviewed.

tailwind_rationale.Private financials: Credit-cycle upturn, GST-driven consumption, multiple brokerages overweight.
tailwind_rationale.Defense & strategic manufacturing: Strongest structural case of the five: ~32%/yr EPS growth forecast (Goldman Sachs, FY25-28), FY26 order approvals ~2x annual capex outlay. Valuations already rich - expect strong P8 but often weak P7, by design.
tailwind_rationale.Capital goods & infrastructure: Private capex flagged as a strong growth driver from late 2027 onward.

excluded_rationale.IT services: Excluded despite appearing on some 2026 broker top-sector lists. Structural AI-driven repricing of the labour-intensive services model (Nifty IT down ~28% YTD 2026, revenue-hiring decoupling for the first time in the industry's history) outweighs the bull case for a 3-year structural pick.

_excluded_note: Excluded despite appearing on 2026 broker top-sector lists - structural AI repricing of labour-intensive services (spec section 3 P8).
_sector_index_note: Maps Screener.in industry to the NSE sectoral index used for the P7 PB benchmark.
